title: The Model Hears You: Audio Language Model Deployments Should Consider the Principle of Least Privilege

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model outputs on decision-making tasks (such as promotion suggestions, job advising, and salary propositions) when given audio inputs of male versus female voices speaking identical text transcripts. It also evaluates the model's capability to directly infer a speaker's gender from voice audio.

Evaluating the model's ability to directly infer a speaker's race/ethnicity from audio recordings using both vanilla and jailbreaking prompts across different simulated sensitive scenarios (e.g., harmful stereotyping, school dress code violations, and rape case adjudication) using the Meta Fair-speech Dataset.
